title: Law of Georgia on Accounting, Reporting and Audit (Article 7: management report with non-financial statement for public interest entities)
citation: Law of Georgia No 5386-IIს of 8 June 2016, published on matsne.gov.ge 24.06.2016 (registration code 260000000.05.001.018170)
evidence: Article 30(1), English edition of 2017-12-23: "This Law, except for Article 5(6)(b), Article 7, Article 8, Article 13(5)(b) and Article 26(1) of this Law, shall enter into force upon its promulgation." The page header reads "Source and date of publishing: Website, 24/06/2016"; first publication on matsne is the official promulgation (Organic Law on Normative Acts Art. 26(1)). Article 30(2): Article 7 (management report) enters into force from 1 January 2018. Opened https://matsne.gov.ge/en/document/view/3311504 on 2026-11-03.
notes: Article 7 requires a management report from public interest entities (PIEs) and first and second category enterprises; Article 7(2)(c) and 7(8) add a non-financial statement (environmental, social, employment, human rights and corruption matters) for PIEs of the first size category with more than 500 employees on average (Article 7(5)). Article 7 itself applies from 2018-01-01; the in_force above is the first date any part of the Law applied, and the 2016-06-24 record is the as-first-published text. Stored on 2026-11-03: 18 Georgian (ka) records and 1 English (en) translation records: one record per edition the Legislative Herald serves, 2016-06-24 (as published, adopted) to 2026-04-01. Edition 9 (stated validity 2019-11-26 to 2019-11-26) is zero-length and not stored. English: matsne serves an English text for the edition valid from 2017-12-23 only (its last amendment footnote is the Law of 23 December 2017); the English pages of the other 17 editions contain only the title, so no other English version exists to store. No Russian or Abkhaz text is stored (neither is an official language served by matsne for this Law).

title: Law of Georgia on Environmental Protection (Article 5-1: protection of the climate; greenhouse gas emission duties of operators)
citation: Law of Georgia No 519-Iს of 10 December 1996, Parliamentary Gazette 1-2(33-34/7), 22.01.1997 (registration code 360.000.000.05.001.000.184)
evidence: Closing article, English edition of 2015-11-11: "The Law of Georgia on Environmental Protection shall enter into force upon its promulgation." The page header reads "Source and date of publishing: Parliamentary Gazette, 1-2(33-34/7), 22/01/1997". Opened https://matsne.gov.ge/en/document/view/33340 on 2026-11-03.
notes: General environmental framework law, not a climate act. Article 5-1 (heading in the English edition: Article 51, Protection of the climate from global changes) obliges an operator to comply with greenhouse gas emission standards and reduce emissions; Article 4 defines a verifier of annual greenhouse gas emission reports. No separate climate framework act is published on matsne.gov.ge on 2026-11-03 (title searches in Georgian and English for climate, greenhouse gas and emission found none; the only climate-named enacted acts are the Climate Change Council ordinance, the NDC approval and municipal plans). Stored on 2026-11-03: 37 Georgian (ka) records and 17 English (en) translation records (1997-01-22 as published to 2026-06-24). Editions 31 and 37 carry an inverted stated validity range (2023-06-29 to 2023-06-16 and 2026-06-25 to 2026-06-24) and are not stored. English exists for the editions valid from 2015-11-11, 2016-04-13, 2016-06-08, 2017-03-23, 2017-06-01, 2017-12-07, 2018-07-05, 2019-10-15, 2020-05-22, 2020-07-14, 2020-07-15, 2021-03-02, 2023-06-16, 2023-06-28, 2025-05-13, 2025-06-12, 2026-04-28; earlier English pages hold only the title.

title: Law of Georgia on the Protection of Consumer Rights (umbrella for misleading commercial practices)
citation: Law of Georgia No 1455-VIIIმს-Xმპ of 29 March 2022, published on matsne.gov.ge 06.04.2022 (registration code 240110010.05.001.020542)
evidence: Article 39(1), English edition of 2022-06-01: "This Law shall enter into force from 1 June 2022 except for Articles 28, 29(2) to (4) and Articles 30 to 36 of this Law." Article 39(2): those Articles enter into force from 1 November 2022. Opened https://matsne.gov.ge/en/document/view/5420598 on 2026-11-03.
notes: Umbrella law: it prohibits misleading and aggressive commercial practices (Georgian Articles 24 and 25; the heading of Article 25 is misleading commercial practice by action). The stored English edition has no provision naming environmental or climate claims (the word environment occurs once), so any green-claims rule is derived from the general misleading-practice rule and is not stated. Stored on 2026-11-03: 4 Georgian (ka) records and 4 English (en) translation records: the as-published text (dated 2022-06-01, the first date the Law applied; the Law was published 2022-04-06) and the editions valid from 2023-06-16, 2023-11-29, 2023-12-15. English exists for all four. The English page of the as-published text contains the text twice; it is stored once.

title: Corporate Governance Code for Commercial Banks (Order No 215/04 of the President of the National Bank of Georgia)
citation: Order No 215/04 of the President of the National Bank of Georgia of 26 September 2018, published on matsne.gov.ge 27.09.2018 (registration code 220020000.18.011.016343)
evidence: Article 3 of the Order: "ეს ბრძანება ამოქმედდეს გამოქვეყნებისთანავე." (this Order enters into force on publication); the page header reads "Source and date of publishing: Website, 27/09/2018". Opened https://matsne.gov.ge/en/document/view/4333402 on 2026-11-03.
notes: The Code as first published (2018). It already mentions ESG (3 times). The current Code is an amended text: ten later orders amend it (Order 244/04 of 2019-12-19, 89/04 of 2020-04-27, 17/04 of 2021-02-09, 69/04 of 2021-06-01, 91/04 of 2021-07-14, 104/04 of 2022-08-24, 363/04 of 2023-12-12, 380/04 of 2023-12-26, 318/04 of 2024-12-27, 127/04 of 2025-05-29). matsne lists 11 publications of this Order, but it is secondary legislation, and matsne shows anonymous users only the initial version: 'Viewing of a consolidated version of the document is paid.' So the consolidated Code is not stored; this record is the 2018 text only. The ESG amendments of 2021 are stored as ge-nbg-cg-code-esg-amendment-2021; the other eight amending orders are not stored in this wave (Order 17/04 of 2021-02-09 is a long text of 55,598 characters that restates much of the Code and is the largest gap). Stored on 2026-11-03: 1 Georgian (ka) records and no English record. No English text: the English page of the Order holds only the Georgian title.

title: Order No 69/04 of the President of the National Bank of Georgia amending the Corporate Governance Code for Commercial Banks (ESG amendments)
citation: Order No 69/04 of the President of the National Bank of Georgia of 1 June 2021, published on matsne.gov.ge 02.06.2021 (registration code for the amended Order 220020000.18.011.016343)
evidence: Article 2 of the Order: "ეს ბრძანება ამოქმედდეს გამოქვეყნებისთანავე." (this Order enters into force on publication); the page header reads "Source and date of publishing: Website, 02/06/2021". Opened https://matsne.gov.ge/en/document/view/5180556 on 2026-11-03.
notes: Binding amending order: banks 'are obliged' (ვალდებულია) to take ESG matters into account in their strategy (Code Art. 3(7)), the supervisory board must oversee ESG and climate-change risk (Art. 4(1)(r), 17(13)), and Art. 20 requires the bank to disclose corporate governance compliance, including ESG information, in the annual Pillar 3 report under NBG Order 92/04 of 2017-06-22. The NBG ESG reporting templates are not part of this Order. This replaces the register row's earlier reading that binding status rested on the NBG ESG page. Stored on 2026-11-03: 1 Georgian (ka) records and no English record. The record is the amending order as published, not the amended Code. No English text.

title: Ordinance No 248 of the Government of Georgia approving the Technical Regulation on the Management of Fluorinated Greenhouse Gases
citation: Ordinance No 248 of the Government of Georgia of 4 July 2023, published on matsne.gov.ge 05.07.2023 (registration code 300160070.10.003.024081)
evidence: Georgian text, Article 2: "1. დადგენილება, გარდა ამ დადგენილებით დამტკიცებული ტექნიკური რეგლამენტის მე-9 – მე-12 მუხლებისა, ამოქმედდეს 2024 წლის 1 იანვრიდან." (the Ordinance, except Articles 9 to 12 of the Regulation, enters into force on 1 January 2024); paragraph 2: Articles 9 to 12 from 1 May 2024. Opened https://matsne.gov.ge/en/document/view/5855354 on 2026-11-03.
notes: Greenhouse gas control measure for fluorinated gases (certification of undertakings servicing equipment that contains them appears in the text). Classified F2 on the reading that it is a climate mitigation measure, not a framework act; the register has no better family for it. The stored text is the Ordinance with the Technical Regulation as first published; matsne holds no free consolidation of secondary legislation. Stored on 2026-11-03: 1 Georgian (ka) records and no English record. No English text.

title: Order No 235 of the Director of the Civil Aviation Agency approving the Rule for the Reduction and Offsetting of Carbon Dioxide Emissions from International Aviation
citation: Order No 235 of the Director of the LEPL Civil Aviation Agency of 22 November 2023, published on matsne.gov.ge 24.11.2023
evidence: Article 2 of the Order: "ბრძანება ამოქმედდეს 2024 წლის 1 იანვრიდან." (the Order enters into force on 1 January 2024). Opened https://matsne.gov.ge/en/document/view/5974679 on 2026-11-03.
notes: Carbon offsetting duty on aircraft operators for international flights (the title names reduction and compensation of carbon dioxide emissions). Classified F3 because it is the only enacted carbon-offset obligation found; Georgia has no emissions trading system or carbon tax on matsne.gov.ge on 2026-11-03 (title searches in Georgian and English for carbon, emission, emissions trading and greenhouse found no ETS or tax act). Amended by ge-corsia-order-amendment-2026. matsne shows only the initial version to anonymous users. Stored on 2026-11-03: 1 Georgian (ka) records and no English record. No English text.
